answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the sparrow of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, weighted by independent path length, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Work waits on the forge until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the timber of the next round. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
